finding.title: A file your terminal runs every time it starts was added, changed or removed.

items.meaning: This is normal when you or an installer just edited it; many tools add a line there.
items.advice: If you did not, open the file and look at its last lines.

finding.title: A program set to start by itself on this Mac was added, changed or removed.

items.meaning: This is normal right after you install, update or remove an app that works in the background.
items.advice: If you did not just do that, look at the file named here and find out which app it belongs to.

finding.title: A script that git runs by itself in one of your projects was added, changed or removed.

items.meaning: This is normal when you just set up a tool for that project, such as a formatter or a linter.
items.advice: If you did not, read the script before your next commit in that project.
